source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project. Native observations are separate from manual/mathematical expectations.
notes: 52 accepted complete native LCD/status key replays from exact PLUS. Saved directly to project.
Pol(3,4) stores x=5 and y=53.13010235 degrees. Origin Pol(0,0) and negative-radius Rec give Math ERROR, Back selects before closing parenthesis, and prior x/y remain available.
Axis, zero radius and negative coordinates measured in Degree, Radian and Grad. After Pol(1,1) in Radian, x recalls sqrt(2) and y recalls (1/4)*pi, while coordinate pair presentation is decimal.

Inline coordinate components use unary minus and scientific glyphs separately. Mantissa is truncated in paired output: Rec(7e99,30) shows x=6.062177e99, distinguishing truncation from rounding. Long pairs scroll 8 pixels through both scientific components.

LineI displays each label/value on a separate row, with values right aligned. The scientific mantissa is shortened there too. Wrapped expressions and an exactly full seventeen-cell expression reserve the next caret line before results; an independent seventeen-cell scalar sum confirms the same boundary.
Scientific-input closing parenthesis spacing is shared by Pol/Rec and GCD/LCM. These observations do not claim every coordinate-domain boundary or nested side-effect order.
